name: BC Detector
description: ML detection queue consumer (@skyline/detector): building verification + DINOv2 embeddings (owl pipeline: OWL-v2 gate chain; v4 pipeline: retrieval-first, no OWL). No exposed port; downloads multi-GB model weights into the persistent volume on first run. On a fresh database, deploy after BC Web API has booted once (it runs the migrations).

env.description: Postgres connection string — same database as BC Web API. In an ocd stack this is auto-derived at boot from the injected POSTGRES_URL plus POSTGRES_USER/POSTGRES_PASSWORD/POSTGRES_DB (see docker/derive-db-url.sh), so leave it unset. Set it explicitly only for standalone/compose deploys.
Postgres database name for the stack-derived DATABASE_URL. Must match the BC Postgres member.
Password for the restricted skyline_detector runtime role.
Number of detection jobs processed concurrently.
Maximum delivery attempts before a detection job is dead-lettered.

owl pipeline only (ignored by v4, which never loads OWL): box-proposer model — 'owlv2' (current production) or 'owlvit32' (bench-validated, ~8.6x faster proposer stage; loads fp32 ~612 MB, ignoring DETECTOR_DTYPE).

Verification pipeline: 'owl' (OWL-v2 + SegFormer-b2 + CLIP gate chain) or 'v4' (retrieval-first kNN verdict in ~200ms, committed immediately; runs only DINOv2 + SegFormer-b0 + lazy CLIP — no OWL. detection_box = seg-derived box, crop_embedding = full-frame embedding, detection_score stays NULL).
v4 only: path to the reference embedding library JSON. Empty uses the file bundled in the image (services/detector/src/reference-library.json).
Model precision for the big models (OWL-v2 + CLIP): fp16 or fp32 (q8 measured harmful). Owl pipeline mostly; v4 only touches it via the rare lazy CLIP OOD fallback.
Enable the onnxruntime CPU memory arena.
OWL proposal confidence threshold.
Minimum building-pixel fraction for the OWL pipeline.
Minimum skyscraper aspect-ratio score for the OWL pipeline.
Minimum CLIP skyscraper score for the OWL pipeline.
Nearest-neighbor count used by the v4 retrieval verdict.
Out-of-distribution similarity threshold for v4.
Minimum aspect ratio for v4 OOD fallback.
Minimum similarity-weighted passing vote share for v4.
Segmentation input size for v4.
Minimum detected-building blob fraction before v4 requests a zoom crop.
Padding multiplier for v4 zoom recapture.
Maximum person fraction allowed by the v4 scene filter.
Maximum screen fraction allowed by the v4 scene filter.
Maximum indoor-scene fraction allowed by the v4 scene filter.
's3' (production default) — must point at the same bucket as BC Web API. 'local' only works when all services share one filesystem (docker-compose).
Max Postgres connections.
Where telemetry events go.
Content moderation provider. Only 'openai' is currently implemented.
OpenAI project API key used for image moderation.
OpenAI moderation model.
